operating_notes.text: Hintastica Private Limited, a 50:50 JV, recognised a ₹51.91 Cr impairment on goodwill and other assets in Q4FY26 due to sustained underperformance amid intense domestic competition and rising input costs.
Other income in Q4FY26 and FY26 includes ₹13.68 Cr of investment-linked incentives from the Telangana State Investment Promotion Policy for mega projects, recognised by subsidiary Hindware Limited.
The company exited air purifiers, water purifiers, furniture fittings, ceiling and other fans, and air coolers (except e-commerce sales), resulting in a net exceptional charge for FY26.
Sanitaryware plant capacity utilisation for FY26 stood at approximately 82% while faucet plant operated at 89%.
Hintastica Private Limited turnover for FY26 was ₹39.72 Cr with a net worth of ₹66.75 Cr.
NCLT Kolkata sanctioned the composite scheme on 14 October 2026 with appointed date 1 April 2025; the transferor company dissolves without winding up on the Effective Date.
The consumer products business transfers to HHIL Limited and the remaining building products undertaking to Hindware Limited, with shares allotted directly to shareholders of the demerged company.
The scheme is to be accounted for under the pooling of interest method prescribed under Ind AS 103.

timeline.summary: Shareholders approved Mr. Ram Babu Kabra (DIN: 00021886) as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director via postal ballot on 27-Apr-26 with 61.31% votes in favor.
Sandip Somany, Sumita Somany, Shashvat Somany, and 15 other promoter entities declared no encumbrance on shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹662.73 Cr (-5.2% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹19.03 Cr (against a loss of ₹30.95 Cr a year earlier).
Payal M Puri (Company Secretary and Sr. VP Group General Counsel) shared the Q4 FY2025-26 earnings call recording on 20 May 2026 via the provided link.
Hindware Home Innovation hosted its Q4 & FY26 earnings call on May 20, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹2,510 Cr and guiding for 15-20% growth in FY27.

On 3 June 2026, Hindware Home Innovation approved investing up to ₹15 Cr in a rights issue and acquiring Atlantic's 50% stake in joint venture Hintastica for ₹2.79 Cr to make it a wholly owned subsidiary.

NCLT Kolkata Bench sanctioned the composite scheme of arrangement on 14 October 2026, demerging the consumer products business into HHIL Limited and amalgamating the remaining business into Hindware Limited, effective on ROC filing.
